title_zh: 调整窗边拍摄位置以减轻反光

scenario.label_zh: 调整窗边拍摄位置以避免强烈反光
scenario.goal_zh: 识别画面中的窗面反光并约定换角度试拍

context_zh: 摄影同伴 Asha 与 Leo 检查刚在窗边拍摄的一张花瓶照片。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: That ray of sunlight across the window looks lovely, but I can see myself in the glass.

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: The reflection is especially pronounced in the lower corner of your photo.

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: I could crop it, but then I'd lose half the vase.

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: Try a different angle before changing the composition.

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: I'll move a little to the left and take another frame.

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: Good. Then we'll compare the reflections before choosing the final image.
